analysis.purpose: Wires the MCP server into each supported IDE config file so a user never hand-edits JSON or TOML to connect their editor.
responsibilities: Write an idempotent managed block into each client config
Preserve sibling content byte-for-byte on every write
Default to an absolute binary path so GUI-launched editors resolve it

businessRules.rule: Writes are idempotent managed blocks that never clobber sibling content.
businessRules.rationale: These are user-owned config files shared with other tools.

businessRules.rule: The binary path defaults to an absolute resolved path.
businessRules.rationale: A GUI-launched IDE does not inherit the shell PATH.

nodes.name: MCP client wiring
nodes.summary: Idempotent IDE configuration for the server.

edges.rationale: This file implements MCP client installation.
